summary: More Ansible 15 community.general deprecations: keycloak_role and keycloak_user* redirects (removed in 16.0.0), the lldp redirect to lldp_facts, the osx_say redirect to say, and yum_versionlock (use community.general.dnf_versionlock).

answer_card.title: yum_versionlock is deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: `community.general.yum_versionlock` will be removed in community.general 16.0.0. Use `community.general.dnf_versionlock` instead. Also rename `lldp` to `community.general.lldp_facts` and `osx_say` to `community.general.say`.
